---
title: "School and College Enrollment Validation"
subtitle: "Does PopulationSim's synthetic population match real K-12 and college enrollment?"
---

## Purpose

This site checks the [PopulationSim](https://github.com/WFRCAnalytics/TDM-INP-PopulationSim)
synthetic population behind WFRC's travel demand model against real school and college enrollment.
The study area is Box Elder, Davis, Weber, Salt Lake, and Utah counties. K-12 enrollment is compared
by **school district**. College enrollment is compared by **county**.

PopulationSim does not control on school enrollment, so each comparison runs two ways:

- **Enrollment status (the real test).** The synthetic population's school-grade label (`SCHG`) is
  uncontrolled, so it is compared directly with actual enrollment.
- **Age population (a sanity bound).** Age is controlled in PopulationSim. The population in the
  school-age band should meet or exceed enrollment. It is not expected to match exactly.

## Comparisons at a glance

| Level | Real reference | Synthetic: enrolled | Synthetic: age band |
|---|---|---|---|
| K-12, by district | Utah DOE school counts (K-12 + preschool); NCES CCD public schools (K-12 + PK) | `SCHG` 1-14, any age | Ages 3-18 |
| College, by county | USHE (public institutions, all levels, Academic Year 2025 Term 2); IPEDS campus-based (fall 2023) | `SCHG` 15 (undergraduate) and 16 (graduate), any age | Ages 18-24 |

## Pages

| Page | What it does | Status |
|---|---|---|
| [1. Geography](1_geography.qmd) | Builds the school-to-district and college-to-county crosswalks. MAZ rows in both let PopulationSim output roll up. Checks coverage and maps the study area. | Done |
| [2. Enrollment](2_enrollment.qmd) | Real K-12 enrollment by district (Utah DOE, NCES CCD, NCES private) and college enrollment by county (USHE, IPEDS). Compares the sources. | Done |
| [3. Synthetic population](3_synthetic.qmd) | Rolls PopulationSim persons up to district and county by school grade and by age. | Done, except the Box Elder clip |
| [4. Validation](4_validation.qmd) | Real against synthetic, by district and by county: tables, scatter plots, and level charts. | Districts and counties done; Box Elder and the summary are still to do |

## How the site is built

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    subgraph sources["Data sources"]
        UGRC["UGRC / Open SGID\ncounty, district, school and college boundaries and locations; DOE school counts"]
        NCES["NCES\nCCD public schools, Private School Universe Survey, postsecondary locations"]
        IPEDS["IPEDS\nFall Enrollment and institutional control"]
        CENSUS["Census TIGER (via pygris)\ncounties and blocks; blocks are not used in the crosswalks"]
        MAZSRC["MAZ microzones\ndraft layer supplied for Utah"]
        TAZSRC["WFRC WasatchFrontTAZ\nreference layer only"]
        USHE["USHE\nenrollment by institution and site"]
        PSIM["PopulationSim persons\nsynthetic population, local only"]
    end

    UGRC --> GEO
    NCES --> GEO
    CENSUS --> GEO
    MAZSRC --> GEO
    TAZSRC -.-> GEO
    GEO["1_geography.qmd\nschool and college crosswalks"] --> XWALK[("crosswalk_school.csv\ncrosswalk_college.csv")]

    XWALK --> ENR
    UGRC --> ENR
    NCES --> ENR
    IPEDS --> ENR
    USHE --> ENR
    ENR["2_enrollment.qmd\nreal enrollment by district and county"] --> ENR_OUT[("real_enrollment_by_district.csv\nreal_enrollment_by_county.csv")]

    XWALK --> SYN
    PSIM --> SYN
    SYN["3_synthetic.qmd\nPopulationSim rollups"] --> SYN_OUT[("synthetic_k12_by_district.csv\nsynthetic_college_by_county.csv")]

    ENR_OUT --> VAL
    SYN_OUT --> VAL
    VAL["4_validation.qmd\nreal against synthetic"]
```

The pages run in order. Each one writes CSV and GeoJSON files to `_data/intermediate/`, and the next
page reads them. The charts are built in Observable JavaScript from those files, so they update on
every render.

## Known limitations

- **Box Elder is only partly inside the model region.** Synthetic persons exist only inside model MAZs,
  so Box Elder needs clipping to the model boundary before it can be compared. That clip is still a TODO.
- **USHE and IPEDS are not like-for-like.** USHE covers public institutions only and is Academic Year
  2025. IPEDS includes private institutions and is fall 2023. The county validation has an option to
  include private institutions.
- **Residence against location.** Synthetic college counts are where students live. IPEDS counts by
  institution location, and USHE counts by site.
- **Charter schools** are included in the district totals. Whether Utah DOE credits their enrollment to
  the resident district has not been checked against DOE's published totals.
- **Online-only schools** have no geographic catchment, so they are left out of the district totals and
  reported separately.
- **Private schools** (NCES Private School Universe Survey) appear on the enrollment page but not in the
  district validation table.

Code, setup, and how to re-render the site are in the
[project README](https://github.com/WFRCAnalytics/TDM-VAL-SchoolCollegeEnrollment#readme).
